title: Rootstock PowPeg flyover

schema.witness: OP_NOTIF, a multisig of 33-byte keys, ELSE, a number, CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY, DROP, a second multisig, ENDIF
schema.keys: 33 bytes each. A 65-byte key is not this row
schema.prefix: an optional 32-byte push and DROP, the flyover prefix

note: Knots #481 names this powpeg. The script is not checked against an address Rootstock publishes. This row clears only the fake-multisig mark. It does not copy the field budget. It stays off until turned on. Any other script stays spam.
